--========================================================
-- ⚡ SHUBU FONTS CHAT :D
-- SAFE / ROBLOX STUDIO VERSION
-- Put this LocalScript in:
-- StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts
--========================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--========================================================
-- SETTINGS
--========================================================

local GUI_NAME = "SHUBU_FONTS_CHAT"
local NOTIFICATION_TIME = 5

--========================================================
-- SAFE STYLE ENGINE
-- No mathematical Unicode fonts.
-- This prevents □ missing-glyph characters.
--========================================================

local styles = {}

local function addStyle(name, formatter)
	table.insert(styles, {
		Name = name,
		Format = formatter
	})
end

-- Basic
addStyle("Normal", function(t)
	return t
end)

addStyle("Spaced", function(t)
	local result = ""

	for _, code in utf8.codes(t) do
		result ..= utf8.char(code) .. " "
	end

	return result
end)

addStyle("Wide", function(t)
	local result = ""

	for _, code in utf8.codes(t) do
		local c = utf8.char(code)

		if c == " " then
			result ..= "  "
		else
			result ..= c .. " "
		end
	end

	return result
end)

-- Safe decorations
local decorations = {
	{"Stars", "★ ", " ★"},
	{"Spark", "✦ ", " ✦"},
	{"Lightning", "⚡ ", " ⚡"},
	{"Diamond", "◆ ", " ◆"},
	{"Circle", "● ", " ●"},
	{"Arrow", "➤ ", ""},
	{"DoubleArrow", "» ", " «"},
	{"Crown", "♛ ", " ♛"},
	{"Music", "♪ ", " ♪"},
	{"Dot", "• ", " •"},
	{"Plus", "✚ ", " ✚"},
	{"Cross", "✧ ", " ✧"},
	{"Dash", "— ", " —"},
	{"Question", "? ", " ?"},
	{"Exclaim", "! ", " !"},
	{"Slash", "/ ", " /"},
	{"Hash", "# ", " #"},
	{"Equal", "= ", " ="},
	{"Gaming", "乂 ", " 乂"},
	{"Aura", "亗 ", " 亗"},
	{"Fire", "🔥 ", " 🔥"},
	{"Cool", "😎 ", " 😎"},
	{"Love", "❤ ", " ❤"},
	{"Game", "🎮 ", " 🎮"},
	{"Rocket", "🚀 ", " 🚀"},
	{"Star", "⭐ ", " ⭐"},
	{"Boom", "💥 ", " 💥"},
}

for _, data in ipairs(decorations) do
	local name = data[1]
	local left = data[2]
	local right = data[3]

	addStyle(name, function(t)
		return left .. t .. right
	end)
end

-- Bracket styles
local brackets = {
	{"Round", "(", ")"},
	{"Square", "[", "]"},
	{"Curly", "{", "}"},
	{"Angle", "<", ">"},
	{"Double", "<<", ">>"},
	{"Triple", "<<<", ">>>"},
	{"Dash", "- ", " -"},
	{"Equals", "= ", " ="},
	{"Slash", "/ ", " /"},
	{"Backslash", "\\ ", " \\"},
	{"Pipe", "| ", " |"},
}

for _, data in ipairs(brackets) do
	local name = data[1]
	local left = data[2]
	local right = data[3]

	addStyle(name, function(t)
		return left .. t .. right
	end)
end

-- Combination styles
for _, deco in ipairs(decorations) do
	for _, bracket in ipairs(brackets) do
		local name = deco[1] .. " + " .. bracket[1]

		addStyle(name, function(t)
			return deco[2] .. bracket[2] .. t .. bracket[3] .. deco[3]
		end)
	end
end

-- More combinations
for _, deco1 in ipairs(decorations) do
	for _, deco2 in ipairs(decorations) do

		if #styles < 1000 then
			addStyle(
				deco1[1] .. " + " .. deco2[1],
				function(t)
					return deco1[2] .. t .. deco1[3]
						.. " "
						.. deco2[2] .. deco2[3]
				end
			)
		end
	end

	if #styles >= 1000 then
		break
	end
end

--========================================================

local function clearList()
	for _,child in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
		if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function renderFonts(filter)
	clearList()

	local count = 0

	for index,style in ipairs(styles) do
		local matches =
			filter == ""
			or string.find(
				string.lower(style.Name),
				string.lower(filter),
				1,
				true
			)

		if matches then
			count += 1

			local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
			button.Size = UDim2.new(1,-5,0,30)

			-- IMPORTANT:
			-- Button itself uses normal Roblox font.
			-- No unsupported Unicode mathematical glyphs.
			button.Text = style.Name .. "  •  SHUBHAM"
			button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
			button.TextSize = 13
			button.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
			button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24,24,32)
			button.BorderSizePixel = 0
			button.Parent = scroll

			local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,8)
			corner.Parent = button

			button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				selectedStyle = style
				refreshPreview()
			end)
		end
	end

	scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0,count * 35)
end

	clearList()

	local count = 0

		if filter == "" or string.find(emoji,filter,1,true) then

			corner.Parent = button

				input.Text ..= emoji
				refreshPreview()
			end)
		end
	end

	scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0,count * 35)
end

--========================================================
-- DRAG SYSTEM
--========================================================

local function makeDraggable(object)
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart
	local startPosition

	object.InputBegan:Connect(function(inputObject)
		if inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = true
			dragStart = inputObject.Position
			startPosition = object.Position

			inputObject.Changed:Connect(function()
				if inputObject.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inputObject)
		if not dragging then
			return
		end

		if inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
